company_name: Fraunhofer IPMS - Institute for Photonic Microsystems
semiconductor_relevance: High — Fraunhofer IPMS is deeply involved in the research and development of electronic and photonic microsystems, which are critical for various semiconductor applications.
summary: Fraunhofer IPMS specializes in the development of MEMS, photonics, and nanoelectronics, providing services from concept development to pilot manufacturing on 200 and 300 mm platforms. Their expertise in trustworthy electronics and advanced packaging technologies positions them as a key player in the semiconductor value chain.
capabilities: Pilot manufacturing of MEMS and photonic microsystems
